items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I’ve got to tell you about Sal and Arthur. If not for these two lovely gentlemen I wouldn’t even be here.

ctx.x: I haven’t dismissed you yet. This is only the first part of my life. I’ve got to tell you about Sal and Arthur. If not for these two lovely gentlemen I wouldn’t even be here.
You’re going from here — what time do you have to work tonight?
